responsibility: Provides shorthand single-token typedef-style macros for PowerPC vector data types used by the Cell/VMX compatibility headers. It names common 128-bit vector element layouts such as vec_uchar16, vec_short8, vec_uint4, vec_float4, and related bool/pixel aliases, serving as the basic type vocabulary consumed by si2vmx.h and spu2vmx.h rather than backend code generation itself.
